subject: Observability assimilation & week-one implementation agenda
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@orbitanalytics.com>, Priya Nair <priya@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T15:15:00Z
Subject: Observability assimilation & week-one implementation agenda

Hi Amit / Priya —

Great to kick off Orbit's observability work. Per our discovery call last week, the implementation scope for week one is focused and actionable: dashboards, trace hooks for inference latency, an error taxonomy draft, and basic alert routing into your PagerDuty team.

I propose this agenda for the first week (we can adjust based on your availability):
- Day 1: Kickoff + access verification (API keys, staging agent, S3 logs)
- Day 2: Deploy trace hook snippet; validate end-to-end trace capture for 3 critical flows
- Day 3: Install dashboard template + map service/route tags
- Day 4: Error taxonomy workshop (5 canonical error buckets + sample alerts)
- Day 5: Runbook handoff & small-fire drill (failover + escalation test)

I attached a compact runbook and the dashboard seed for your engineers to review. Can you confirm two engineer attendees for the hands-on sessions (Dev + Platform)? Also, which timezone is best for daily 45-min checkpoints?

Next steps: if you confirm, Marissa will send an implementation calendar and a pre-checklist.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: obs_runbook_v1.md (runbook stub), dashboard_template_orbit.json (Grafana seed)
From: Amit Shah <amit@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability assimilation & week-one implementation agenda

Ben —

Thanks, this looks good and very actionable. Quick answers:
- I'll be the primary contact; my lead infra engineer Priya Nair (cc'd) will attend the hands-on sessions.
- Timezone: Pacific (PDT) mornings work best — 9:30–10:15 PT preferred.
- Access: we'll provision a staging S3 bucket and create a service account this afternoon. Expect keys by EOD.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can we prioritize a latency breakdown per model (cold vs warm starts) in the dashboard?
2) We have strict alerting policy for production — would like to review sample alert severity mappings before you wire PagerDuty.

I'll upload our current incident matrix to the Drive link and tag you.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T19:27:00Z
Subject: FW: Observability assimilation & week-one implementation agenda

Marissa / Laura —

Looping you in after Orbit confirmed Priya + morning PDT slot. Key asks to surface for the implementation calendar:
- Priya wants a per-model latency breakdown (cold vs warm). We should include a dashboard panel and a short walkthrough of how KV-cache warmups surface in traces.
- They want to review alert severity mappings before we wire PagerDuty. Let's prepare a 1-pager mapping sample alerts -> severity -> oncall routing.

Marissa: can you prepare the calendar invite for 9:30 PT start times next week and attach the pre-checklist items we require (staging keys, service account, test payloads, PD routing key)? Also include the runbook and snippet attachments from my initial email.

Laura: I'll need you to own the error taxonomy workshop — draft 5 canonical error buckets (validation, model-failure, infra, rate-limit/backpressure, data-quality) and two sample alert messages per bucket. We can iterate in the workshop.

Thanks — I'll announce the kickoff once invites are ready.

Ben

(On a separate note: Priya indicated stricter policy on production alerts; if it looks like we'll need a policy exception for warmup noise, flag it early.)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@orbitanalytics.com>, Priya Nair <priya@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-23T01:12:00Z
Subject: Implementation calendar + pre-checklist (Orbit observability)

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks for confirming. Attached are the artifacts for week one and the invite series for daily 45-min checkpoints at 9:30 PT:
- obs_runbook_v1.md — compact runbook we will use for the run-through on Day 5 (contains escalation tree + play-by-play)
- dashboard_template_orbit.json — Grafana seed with model-latency panels (cold/warm) and token-level throughput
- trace_hook_snippet.py — small instrumentation snippet to place near the inference client to emit spans and cold-start markers

Pre-checklist (please complete before Day 1):
1) Provision staging service account + grant s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject to redwood-staging-<orbit> (we only need read access for logs).
2) Drop a 5-minute sample log file at s3://orbit-staging/logs/sample-05m.json (we'll use this for dashboard seed validation).
3) Provide a PagerDuty test routing key for the staging team (we will not wire prod PD keys).
4) Confirm two attenders per session: Priya (platform) + one dev (name/email).

Day-by-day tweaks: we will prioritize the per-model cold/warm panel first on Day 2 so you get an immediate latency lens. Laura will run the error taxonomy workshop on Day 4; Ben will join Day 5 for the failover drill.

If anything on the checklist is a blocker, reply here and we'll adjust the sequence. Looking forward to the sessions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: obs_runbook_v1.md, dashboard_template_orbit.json, trace_hook_snippet.py

Date: 2026-03-24T01:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Implementation calendar + pre-checklist (Orbit observability)

Marissa —

Received, thank you. Priya and I will complete the checklist by end of day tomorrow. A couple quick confirmations:
- Dev attendee: Mark Lee (mark.lee@orbitanalytics.com)
- PagerDuty staging routing key uploaded to the Drive doc you linked (please verify you can use it in staging)
- We'll prioritize the cold/warm latency panel as requested.

Looking forward to Day 1. If anything else is needed from our side, ping me.

—Amit
